dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary light-intensity structures on the lateral flank exhibit sharp gradient transitions from a dark outer perimeter to a high-intensity interior. These include a centrally located closed 'O' shape with a well-defined circular boundary, an elongated 'C' shape positioned towards the posterior, and a smaller, high-contrast annulus situated dorsally above the mid-body line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a low spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, visible primarily near the posterior-ventral margin. A secondary cluster of small, low-intensity solid blobs is interspersed between the larger macro-annuli on the upper dorsal-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli form a scalene triangle on the lateral plane. The distance between the central and posterior annuli centroids is approximately 1.8 times the distance between the central and dorsal-aligned annuli, forming an obtuse angle at the central centroid.
